budget_limits: Conditional on frozen prices and token envelope; halt on observed breaches. No cache discounts assumed; all input charged at cache-write rate. No invoice/tax guarantee.

data.training_source_access: byte checksum and CSV positions; retain only 770 validation texts/labels

pricing.scope: Standard, nonregional, <=272000 input tokens, no tools; excluding taxes/credits
